title: Goose Island’s Aged This Bourbon County Stout In Birthday Bourbon And King Of Kentucky Barrels. Here’s The Result
summary: The 2026 Bourbon County Triple Barrel Stout spent 43 months aging in three sets of bourbon barrels, including ones that previously held two of Kentucky’s most coveted whiskeys.
